name: Twilio
one_liner: Twilio provides a comprehensive suite of APIs for communications (messaging, voice, video, email), authentication, and customer data, enabling developers to programmatically interact with various communication channels.
access_note: Developers can create API keys or use Account SID and Auth Token from the Twilio Console to access the API.

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, use HTTP Basic authentication. Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
You can create an API key either in the Twilio Console or using the API.
Twilio APIs use standard RESTful HTTP methods to perform actions on resources.
Use a Twilio SDK for your preferred programming language. Use the Twilio CLI if you prefer working in the terminal.
